name: Chill Fishing
hook: Cast at sunset. Reel in something rare.
how: Hold to cast and let go at full power: far casts reach rarer fish. Tap when the bobber dunks, then hold to reel and let go whenever the fish pulls, or the line snaps. Twelve fish to collect, from Reed Minnows to the Moonfin.
controls: Hold Space, click or the CAST button to cast and reel; A/D or ◀ ▶ to change spots; Enter to chat, 1 to 4 for emotes
uses: Your fish log (every species you've caught and your biggest of each) is saved for next time.
Friendly bots fish, chat and cheer on the dock until people arrive.
Everyone sees each other cast, reel, emote and hold up their catch.
Raise the odds of rare fish or run a fishing event without touching the code.
ideas: Add a shop that sells better rods with the fish you catch
Make it a frozen lake with ice-fishing holes
Add a weekly fishing contest for the biggest catch
